cases.prompt: A search job was preempted after writing some designs and oracle refolds. Resume the campaign without losing completed work.
expected_behavior: Reconciles artifacts and records missing or failed outputs explicitly
Creates a linked retry run instead of overwriting the interrupted run

cases.prompt: Show exactly why design d17 is a passer and where it came from.
expected_behavior: Traces the design to its annotated CIF, resolved config, run, and parent lineage
Reports the named criteria-set version and actual metric values
Links oracle-derived values to exact oracle predictions
Does not infer provenance from filenames
